description: This file defines a RedisSource structure and functions for integrating hiredis with GLib's main event loop, including adding/removing read/write events, cleanup, and creating new sources.

methods.name: redis_source_add_read
methods.description: Adds read event to RedisSource and wakes up the main context.

methods.name: redis_source_del_read
methods.description: Removes read event from RedisSource and wakes up the main context.

methods.name: redis_source_add_write
methods.description: Adds write event to RedisSource and wakes up the main context.

methods.name: redis_source_del_write
methods.description: Removes write event from RedisSource and wakes up the main context.

methods.name: redis_source_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up RedisSource by removing read/write events and poll.

methods.name: redis_source_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the RedisSource for polling, setting timeout.

methods.name: redis_source_check
methods.description: Checks if RedisSource has events to process.

methods.name: redis_source_dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches events for RedisSource, handling read/write and invoking callback.

methods.name: redis_source_new
methods.description: Creates a new GSource for redisAsyncContext, setting up event handlers.
